chapter: Minton's, bop and the Monk circle
title: Bud Powell, Monk's big band and the house that built bop
summary: Bud idolised Monk and played his compositions; the big band disbanded and everyone jammed at Minton's, 'the house that built bop'.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with and understanding Thelonious Monk

blocks.x: Then to get back to Monk and his big band, they were rehearsing in the cellar and then they had to get out and get some jobs?
Yes, Monk and Bud Powell were together. I don't know how they were doing it, but Bud idolized Monk. He always did. Monk would write great compositions and Bud would actually play them very well.
So when you say they were together, you mean they were both involved with the big band.
Who else was in the big band?
I don't remember because they were musicians -
Did they ever get out of the cellar?
Yes, they had to. They got very hungry.
No, I think it disbanded. All the guys used to hang out at Minton's and play.
So that was how Monk got playing at Minton's, because -
Yes, that was how all the new era of music started up at Minton's, you know they named it the House that Built Bop. Well, they did, because I happen to know that.
